Joins Montgomery tracts with EPA facility counts and CDC PLACES adult asthma prevalence, computes EPA facilities per 1,000 residents, and returns each paired tract with the overall correlation and paired-tract count ordered by facility density.
sql:
WITH epa AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS epa_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_667e57' AND source = 'm1_cdc' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
         CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence_pct
  FROM session.fw_667e57_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.geoid,
         t.name,
         e.epa_count,
         h.totalpopulation,
         h.totalpop18plus,
         h.adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
         (e.epa_count / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN epa e ON e.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE e.epa_count IS NOT NULL
    AND h.adult_asthma_prevalence_pct IS NOT NULL
    AND h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
    AND h.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT name,
       epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation,
       epa_count,
       totalpopulation,
       adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
       totalpop18plus,
       CORR(epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation, adult_asthma_prevalence_pct) OVER () AS epa_asthma_correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
